services.name: Disc golf
services.desc: The 18-Hole disc golf course at Thompson Grove Park is a nearly 9,000 feet long and with a par of 64. Drive to the back of the park to find hole 1 and 2 practice baskets. The course features Blue (Advanced), White (Intermediate), and Red (Beginner) tees and a handful of Gold (Pro) tees. The Blue tees are extremely challenging and can be discouraging for some players. The Grove is maintained by a small group of volunteers. This involves weed-whacking, carrying off branches, removing debris, communicating with the township, and anything else to improve the course.
